title: From Vanishing Gradients to Recursive Self-Improvement: Evaluating the Most Influential Papers in Large Language Model Evolution (1997-2026)
abstract: arXiv:2611.29303v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of Large Language Model (LLM) research makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish incremental refinements from true paradigm shifts. This review evaluates 22 of the most influential publications spanning nearly three decades (1997-2026), organized through a causal, chronologically anchored taxonomy centered on the author's birth year (1999). Beginning "before 1999" with how recurrent neural networks (RNNs) forgot earlier context (much like forgetting Chapter 1 by the time a reader reaches Chapter 9), we trace how Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks introduced a "bouncer" mechanism of forget, input, and output gates to selectively preserve long-term memory. We then examine how Word2Vec turned language into vector mathematics (king - male + female ~ queen), why sequential RNNs hit a parallelization wall, and how the Transformer's all-to-all attention weights launched the modern LLM era alongside a quadratic

translated_title: 从梯度消失到递归自我改进：评估大语言模型演进中最具影响力的论文（1997-2026）
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）研究的迅速激增，使得区分渐进式改进与真正的范式转变变得越来越困难。本综述评估了近三十年间（1997-2026）最具影响力的22篇出版物，并采用一种以作者出生年份（1999年）为中心的、基于因果关系的按时间顺序锚定的分类体系进行组织。从“1999年之前”开始，探讨循环神经网络（RNN）如何遗忘较早的上下文（就像读者读到第9章时早已忘记第1章的内容），我们追溯了长短期记忆网络（LSTM）如何引入一种由遗忘门、输入门和输出门构成的“门卫”机制来选择性地保留长期记忆。随后，我们考察了Word2Vec如何将语言转化为向量数学（king - male + female ≈ queen），为什么串行处理的RNN遇到了并行化的瓶颈，以及Transformer的全对全注意力权重机制如何开启了现代LLM时代，并同时带来了二次方复杂度的……
tldr: 本综述按时间线评估了1997-2026年间22篇最具影响力的大语言模型论文，梳理了从RNN、LSTM、Word2Vec到Transformer的关键技术演进脉络。
en_tdlr: This review chronologically evaluates 22 of the most influential LLM papers from 1997 to 2026, tracing the key technological evolution from RNNs, LSTMs, and Word2Vec to the Transformer era.
